title: Shape-engineered Ag/Ag2O/CuO nanostructures for synergistic agrochemical remediation and microbial inhibition
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2710-2725
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00156K, Paper
Monika Kherwal, Akanksha Gupta, Ravinder Kumar, Vijay Kumar Goel, Ajay Kumar Mishra, Priyanka Jhajharia, Vinod Kumar
Groundwater pollution from the widespread use of herbicide isoproturon in agriculture is a significant concern. We synthesize Ag/Ag2O/CuO nanocomposite to degrade isoproturon into non-toxic compounds.
